_comment: Copy to the run host (outside the kit's folder), fill in every <placeholder>, and pass it with -SettingsPath. No secret goes here: the run signs in with a certificate in the run account's or the machine's store, or with a managed identity. Paths are absolute or relative to this file. Leave 'kits' out when the four kits sit beside estate-inventory, as they do in the repository and in estate-inventory-code.zip.
